title: New household debt report and groceries/bills
discussion_signal: The thread interprets record household debt as linked to emergencies, groceries, and bills rather than only discretionary consumption. Replies debate whether the signal reflects broad distress, medical debt, irresponsible credit use, or delayed reporting.
linked_research_question: How households interpret debt as a buffer for essentials, and whether borrowing protects consumption temporarily or transfers future room and risk.
engagement: Visible vote count was not treated as prevalence or agreement.
limits: Comments mix sourced claims and personal interpretation
Household debt and bill payment outcomes are not verified for participants
